verdicts.reason: Both are unusable on a 160x600 canvas with a white background. A: the headline is clipped at the top of the image band ("Special" is cut off), and "March 21" is nearly invisible cream on white. The CTA, tagline and body copy are all missing. B: the headline is fully legible and sits wholly inside the dark panel, but "Joint celebration" is cut off at the panel edge. "March 21" is cream on white and unreadable, the divider lines float on white, and the body copy and URL are missing. B loses less and keeps the headline intact, so it is less bad.
